app.name: RankPilot
app.tagline: Autonomous AI SEO Agent powered by Gemini 4 Argon
app.offlineDescription: RankPilot works offline with cached navigation and last-viewed project summaries. Reconnect to run live crawls or ask the agent.

topbar.noAlerts: No unread anomaly or audit alerts.

pwa.installDesc: Install on your phone or desktop for 1-click access and offline report viewing.

agentDrawer.title: RankPilot SEO Agent
agentDrawer.phaseNoticeBody: Ask about technical audit findings, Search Console quick wins, content decay, or on-page fixes. Every response cites tool evidence and requires your approval before creating tasks.
agentDrawer.inputPlaceholder: Ask about rankings, technical issues, or quick wins...

landing.badge: Powered by Gemini 4 Argon • Evidence-First SEO
landing.heroTitle: Grow organic & AI search traffic without being an SEO expert.
landing.heroSubtitle: Connect your website. RankPilot audits every page, explains why issues matter in plain language, writes exact copy-paste fixes, and tracks both Google Search and AI citations.
landing.pillar1Body: Every finding includes measured URL evidence, data source, and timestamp. Estimates are explicitly labelled with confidence scores.
landing.pillar2Body: The agent proposes; you decide. Nothing modifies your site or publishes content without your explicit approval.
landing.pillar3Body: Optimize for Google Search, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity with structured data, llms.txt, and citation readiness checks.

auth.signInSubtitle: Access your SEO workspace, project audits, and AI agent controls.
auth.devLoginHint: Enabled because AUTH_DEV_LOGIN=true in non-production mode.

onboarding.title: Connect Your Website
onboarding.subtitle: Add your site and tell RankPilot about your audience and goals. This builds the cached Project Profile used by the SEO Agent.

dashboard.title: Project Overview
dashboard.noCrawlDesc: Run a Site Audit to crawl your website, build the internal link graph, and evaluate 40 deterministic technical, on-page, content, performance, and AI search rules.

settings.title: Account, BYOK API Keys & Budgets
settings.subtitle: All API keys are encrypted server-side with AES-256-GCM and bound to your user ID. Raw keys are never returned to the browser.
settings.byokSectionDesc: Gemini 4 Argon requires a paid-tier Gemini API key. Paid SERP and keyword providers are optional plug-ins and off by default.
settings.budgetSectionDesc: Pre-flight token checks reserve budget before every Gemini request. Calls that would exceed any limit are blocked automatically.
settings.fastModelToggleLabel: Route Low-thinking tasks (intent classification, extraction) to GEMINI_MODEL_FAST when set

projectSettings.title: Project Settings & Agent Profile
projectSettings.subtitle: Configure crawl limits, ownership verification token, team access, and the deterministic Project Profile prefix.
projectSettings.verificationDesc: Unverified projects are limited to 50 crawled pages. Verify via DNS TXT record or HTML meta tag (live check enabled in Phase 2).
